review_scope: Selected eclipse interpretation in hash-verified cached QLP SAP, with bounded follow-up where decisive.
evidence: Raw S12 and S39 show continuously cycling asymmetric 1.5–3-day waves: selected dips near 1630.64, 1633.68, 1635.22 and 2362.70–2370.31 are successive wave troughs. S67, S93, and S102 retain changing, multi-hump modulation. S94 has a broad trend down to the 3874.88 flag near an orbit boundary rather than a discrete repeated eclipse.
interpretation: The selected detector deficits follow smooth evolving variability and baseline structure, with no isolated recurring eclipse shape. This refutes the selected eclipse interpretation; astrophysical non-eclipse variability remains possible.
limitations: No orbital period, eclipse depth or source-specific geometry is measured from these troughs. This does not exclude a different binary signal.
catalogue_status: UNKNOWN; VSX, ASAS-SN, Kostov table 3/4 unavailable
